plain: A model points out what is wrong with its own answer against a written principle, then rewrites the answer to fix it.
eli5: Checking your own homework against a rule, circling the mistakes, then writing it out again neatly.
technical: The supervised stage of Constitutional AI (SL-CAI): a helpful RLHF model answers a red-team prompt, critiques its answer under a randomly drawn principle and revises it, up to four times, and a pretrained model is fine-tuned on the revisions.
